results.title: Daniel is MacArthur Fellow
results.snippet: After a share is set aside for charity and his children's education fund, Daniel plans to use some of the grant money to fund studies that other granting agencies may consider "risky" or "chancy." Daniel is the eighth UW faculty member to win a fellowship since the program started in 1981. Current or former faculty MacArthur Fellows include: John Toews, history, 1984; Caroline Bynum, history, 1986; Richard Kenney, poetry, 1987; Suzanne Lebsock, history, 1992; Leonard van der Kuijp, Asian languages and literature, 1993; Victoria Foe, zoology, 1993; and Richard White, history, 1995.Send a letter to the editor at columns@u.washington.edu.
